\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[english,spanish]{babel}
\makeatletter
\newcommand\checkpatterns[1]{%
  \ifnum\language=\csname l@#1\endcsname\else
    \errmessage{Wrong active hyphenation language}%
  \fi}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\typeout{P1_LANG=\languagename}
\checkpatterns{spanish}

\selectlanguage{english}
\typeout{P2_LANG=\languagename}
\checkpatterns{english}

\selectlanguage{spanish}
\typeout{P3_LANG=\languagename}
\checkpatterns{spanish}

\begin{otherlanguage}{english}
\typeout{P4_LANG=\languagename}
\checkpatterns{english}
\end{otherlanguage}

\typeout{P5_LANG=\languagename}
\checkpatterns{spanish}
\end{document}
